"data" isn't an overlay's folder: lowercase letters, digits, _, - and ., and not "data"
Only worldgen passes through, and tags of blocks: entries go in data/case/worldgen/<registry>/, tags of them in data/case/tags/worldgen/<registry>/, and block tags in data/case/tags/block/
A tag is { "values": [...] } (and "replace": true or false), each an id, a #tag or { "id": … }
